sentences.text: This dinosaur measured approximately 9.1 meters from head to tail with forelimbs estimated at around 2 meters long.
The genus Rukwatitan was described by Gorscak et al. in 2014 and is classified within the unranked family Titanosauria.

Rukwatitan lived in the middle of the Cretaceous period, approximately 100 million years ago during the Albian stage, in what is now Africa. Its time range spans from the Cenomanian to the Campanian, between 100.5 and 72.2 million years ago.
